dedupe_keys.name: data for quantifying uk coastal flood exposure under future sea level rise to 2300

description: Matthew Palmer and James Savage publish data and code for quantifying future coastal flood exposure in the United Kingdom. The March 2026 archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. It combines long-term sea-level storylines with a published national flood model to examine exposure through 2300. The metadata identify those upstream studies, but they are not treated as papers describing this deposited package. These materials can support coastal infrastructure adaptation scenarios or comparisons of exposure across sea-level assumptions. File formats inside the ZIP, asset categories, spatial resolution and uncertainty treatment are not established by the public inventory. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this long-horizon package. The archive was not downloaded, and its projections should not be interpreted as forecasts with verified probabilities. Numerical results and code execution remain unchecked.
